components/button.title: Button
components/button.description: Buttons trigger actions and support semantic variants and sizes.

contributing.title: Contributing
contributing.description: Read the repository contribution guide before opening a pull request. Component changes should use semantic TWANTS tokens, remain keyboard accessible, and include documentation where appropriate.

design/accessibility.title: Accessibility
design/accessibility.description: Use semantic elements, provide visible labels, and preserve the default focus ring.

design/themes.title: Themes
design/themes.description: Set data-theme on the document root to select a theme:

design/tokens.title: Design tokens
design/tokens.description: TWANTS visual primitives are CSS custom properties. Override them at the application boundary to retheme the system.

getting-started/quick-start.title: Quick start
getting-started/quick-start.description: Add a semantic TWANTS class to any HTML element:

integrations/django.title: Django
integrations/django.description: Build or copy the TWANTS stylesheet into your static assets, load it in the base template, and use the semantic classes in Django templates.

integrations/tauri.title: Tauri
integrations/tauri.description: Import twants/styles from the frontend entry point and use the same HTML classes inside the Tauri webview.

integrations/vanilla.title: Vanilla
integrations/vanilla.description: Interactive modules can be imported individually to keep the bundle small.

integrations/wails.title: Wails
integrations/wails.description: TWANTS works in the Wails frontend as a regular CSS and TypeScript dependency. Import the stylesheet once from the frontend entry point.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.description: TWANTS is a framework-agnostic UI system built with semantic HTML, CSS tokens, and small optional JavaScript modules.
